description: This file defines a template class 'bounded_bitset' for a dynamically-sized, bounded bitset with various manipulation, conversion, and formatting methods. It includes features like bitwise operations, slicing, iteration over set bits, and custom formatting support. The class supports different bit orderings (MSB or LSB) and provides utilities for packing/unpacking bits, extracting ranges, and folding operations. It is part of the 'ocudu' namespace and includes integration with the 'fmt' formatting library.

classes.name: bounded_bitset
classes.description: A template class representing a bounded, dynamically-sized bitset with various manipulation, conversion, and formatting methods. Supports different bit orderings and provides utilities for bitwise operations, slicing, iteration, and custom formatting.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the bitset to a new size, sanitizing bits if shrinking.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a specific bit to true or false.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all bits to false.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Sets all bits to true or false.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Appends a bit or multiple bits to the bitset.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts a range of bits as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: to_uint64
methods.description: Converts the bitset to a 64-bit unsigned integer (asserts if size > 64).

methods.name: from_uint64
methods.description: Loads a 64-bit unsigned integer into the bitset (asserts if size > 64 or value doesn't fit).

methods.name: to_packed_bits
methods.description: Converts the bitset into an array of packed bits.

methods.name: to_unpacked_bits
methods.description: Converts the bitset into an array of individual boolean bits.

methods.name: get_bit_positions
methods.description: Returns a list of positions of bits set to 1 or 0.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns a subview (slice) of the bitset.

methods.name: find_lowest
methods.description: Finds the lowest set bit (or zero bit).

methods.name: find_highest
methods.description: Finds the highest set bit (or zero bit).

methods.name: any
methods.description: Checks if any bit is set to 1.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Checks if all bits are set to 1.

methods.name: none
methods.description: Checks if no bits are set to 1.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if bits with a specific value are contiguous.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two bitsets.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two bitsets.

methods.name: flip
methods.description: Inverts all bits.

methods.name: operator|=
methods.description: Bitwise OR assignment.

methods.name: operator&=
methods.description: Bitwise AND assignment.

methods.name: operator~
methods.description: Bitwise NOT (flip).
